authoring.rules: Independent writers see only the operations-v4 sources and question schema. Review labels, exact quotations, and duplicate information needs against earlier questions without running retrieval or either service. Exclusions happen before freezing. Retain every eligible draft question.

candidate.scope: Host-local loopback HTTP service with subscription passage verification explicitly enabled by the server operator.
candidate.retrieval: PostgreSQL pgvector plus full-text hybrid, RRF k=10, BGE-small
candidate.calibration: Use only consumed development and former holdout material. Preserve raw hybrid ranks, corpus, topic list and similarity/coverage thresholds. Validate the existing round 7 passage profile through HTTP before freezing.

measurement.http: Submit each question once per arm to authenticated POST /v1/assist and read the final SSE result. An answer with refused=false is an admission. Report refusal reasons, service or verifier errors, per-request timings, verifier usage, and counts for both arms.
measurement.out_of_scope: Number of unsupported questions admitted divided by all unsupported questions.
measurement.documentation: Number of documentation questions refused divided by all documentation questions.
measurement.retrieval: Compare raw production hybrid rankings against the v1.2 ranking on each documentation question, including refused questions. Recall@5 counts labelled sections among the first five distinct ranked sections.
measurement.intervals: Use 95% Wilson intervals for rates and a 95% paired percentile interval for Recall@5, clustering by the primary documentation section.
measurement.success: All three bounds must pass using unrounded values. An incomplete run or infrastructure error cannot establish a pass.

freeze.policy: Push the protocol before authoring. Push the audited questions, configuration and runner hashes before starting. Exclusively create the run receipt before the first trial request. Preserve a failure or partial run and never replay the cohort. CI checks integrity but does not run the trial.
